entries.name: LSPC15mf 15.6-inch bedside terminal (orange button at the bottom centre)
entries.scope: LSPC15mf only, identified by the orange button at the bottom centre (caller description accepted; bed map not required). Other models use KB-UNKNOWN-HARDWARE
entries.owner_role: Product owner: prototype curation; technical/business approval as applicable
entries.approval: Hardware facts confirmed by Product owner 2026-11-24 (no status light; orange button and short side press = screen off/on; long side press = terminal off/on; no optional extras). Product owner 2026-11-25 (DOC-004): caller description may identify the model; orange-button black-screen step approved. Synthetic development only; no patient-pilot approval
entries.description: Use only when the caller confirms an orange button in the middle of the frame below the screen: no status light, what each button does, volume, headphones and Bluetooth pairing, no remote/handset/NFC/nurse call, and the black-screen step.
entries.review_notes: DOC-004. v1.1 (before any ingestion) adds Product owner 2026-11-25 answers: side volume buttons usable by patients; 3.5 mm jack works; Bluetooth headphones supported (pairing steps unconfirmed, not given); headphones not supplied; buttons normally reachable from bed. v1.2: Bluetooth pairing steps from Product owner 2026-11-25 (APPS > Bluetooth > switch on > Scan & clear paired devices); observed on MF15S as a BLUETOOTH tile in APPS (M46), inside Settings on WSLHD (S23).
entries.evidence_note: Reviewed curated export and Product owner confirmations recorded in supplied manifest; new upstream originals not independently checked in this repository.

entries.name: 21-inch bedside terminals (touch symbols along the bottom, no orange button)
entries.scope: 21-inch terminals, two hardware versions recognised by caller description (A: black glass, eight symbols, no physical buttons; B: white frame with LSPcare logo, nine symbols, rear power button)
entries.owner_role: Product owner: prototype curation; technical/business approval as applicable
entries.approval: Product owner 2026-11-25: both photos are 21-inch terminals with different hardware; power symbol (A) and small screen symbol (B) turn the screen on/off, short touch safe; volume and reading lamp usable; sun = brightness; headphone jack rear middle below arm mount; wired and Bluetooth headphones; patients may pair Bluetooth; handset is internal demo only. Synthetic development only
entries.description: Recognise the two 21-inch versions by their touch symbols; black-screen step (power symbol or small screen symbol); reading lamp, volume, brightness, headphones and Bluetooth pairing; never orange-button steps or the rear power button.
entries.review_notes: DOC-004. v1.1 replaces the recognition-only v1.0 (never ingested). Model name not stated by Product owner; SRC-009 (LSPC21ms) layout matches version A. Rear power button deliberately excluded from caller steps (its function and permitted use not stated).
entries.evidence_note: Reviewed curated export and Product owner confirmations recorded in supplied manifest; new upstream originals not independently checked in this repository.
